0.original: Cuthbert of Quarrymill would seek your aid in recovering a family heirloom.

1.original: The notorious Redbelly Wasps have in their possession a priceless heirloom that once belonged to Cuthbert's grandfather, the elder of the ill-fated village of Boughbury. Venture near Redbelly Hive and recover the axe.

2.original: You have safely recovered the Boughbury Axe from the vicious bandits. Cuthbert will be overjoyed to see it returned after so many years.

3.original: Taking his grandfather's prized heirloom in hand, Cuthbert swears vengeance against those who stole from his family their rightful home.

24.original: Recover the Boughbury Axe near Redbelly Hive.

25.original: Deliver the Boughbury Axe to Cuthbert.

48.original: In the days before the Calamity, my grandfather was village elder of Boughbury. We tried─gods be good, we tried─to reclaim his home, but to no avail. Passed away last year, he did...

49.original: With his last breath, he spoke of a family heirloom, an axe passed down for generations. Now those Redbelly whoresons use it to split wood─mockin' us all the while. The Twelve take me if I allow those bastards to besmirch Grandfather's memory any longer. You'll bring it back for me, won't you?

50.original: Well? Were you able to reclaim the axe from those bloody thieves?

51.original: Just as Grandfather always described it! You're a godssend, friend. Grandfather, I swear to you─the next time a Redbelly sees this axe, it'll be buried in his good-for-naught skull!
